rationale: Charlie's conviction that AI is expanding who can build software aligns directly with Saurabh's work building AI-adjacent developer tools and agentic coding extensions. Saurabh's backend and Android development background combined with his current focus on Python and machine learning could offer practical perspective on how AI tooling integrates with mobile and cross-platform app development—core to Expo's vision of becoming the default platform for this new wave of builders.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet Saurabh Khire — Saurabh is building AI developer tools at HiJenny AI and has the mobile + backend engineering background that could inform how AI tooling works with modern app platforms like Expo.
